meta.description: Complete End-to-End Logistics Document Intelligence & AI Extraction Workflow
meta.instructions:
IMPORT INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Open your n8n dashboard (e.g. https://n8n.provelopers.net)
2. Click 'Workflows' -> 'Import from File' and select this JSON file.
3. Configure your OpenAI API key in the OpenAI HTTP Node credentials.
4. Set active = true and save.

NODE FLOW:
Node 1: Webhook Trigger (receives documentId, storagePath, fileName, callbackUrl)
Node 2: HTTP Request / File Reader (fetches PDF/image from storage)
Node 3: Code Node - PDF/Text OCR Extractor (parses raw text)
Node 4: HTTP Request - OpenAI API Chat Completions (Extracts canonical JSON & confidences)
Node 5: Code Node - Response Formatter & Validation
Node 6: HTTP Request - Node.js Webhook Callback (/api/documents/{documentId}/extraction/callback)

parameter.name: messages
parameter.value: =[{"role":"system","content":"Extract only values explicitly present in the logistics invoice. Return valid JSON with three sections: invoiceHeader, shipmentDetail (array), and chargeLineItems (array). Preserve these field concepts and names: invoiceHeader includes invoiceId, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, shipperName, shipperAddress, shipperTaxId, consigneeName, consigneeAddress, consigneeTaxId, billToName, billToAddress, currency, subtotalAmount, taxAmount, totalAmountDue, timestamp, carrierName, carrierLegalEntityName, billingAccountNumber, invoiceStatus, pageNumber, previousBalance, totalIncentiveDiscount, fuelSurchargeTotal, rateOfExchange, remitToCompanyName, remitToAddress, bankName, bankAccountNumber, swiftCode, iban, latePaymentFeePercentage. shipmentDetail includes invoiceId, shipmentId, shipmentOriginalId, mawbHawb, carrierName, carrierScacCode, modeOfTransport, originPortLocation, destinationPortLocation, pickupDate, deliveryArrivalDate, grossWeight, grossWeightUnit, chargeableWeight, volumeCbm, totalPackageCount, timestamp, trackingNumber, mblNumber, hblNumber, proNumber, poNumberPoReference, internalAccountingCodeSpeedtype, sidNumber, serviceCode, serviceDescription, transportZone, dimensionalWeight, dimensionalWeightUnit, chargeableWeightUnit, packageDimensions, originPortAirportCode, destinationPortAirportCode, dispatchDepartureDate, freightDispatchPlaceOfReceipt, freightFinalDeliveryPlaceOfDelivery, freightClassificationNmfcCode. For ocean shipments only, also extract vesselName, voyageNumber, imoVesselNumber, containerNumber, containerSizeType, custodyTransferTerm, priceCalculationDatePcd, oceanServiceContractNumber, portOfLoadingPol, and portOfDischargePod. For trucking or LTL shipments only, also extract trailerVehicleNumber, intermodalLoadControlReference, freightTermsPrepaidCollect, codAmount, and codServiceFee. chargeLineItems includes invoiceId, shipmentId, lineNo, chargeDescription, standardizedChargeCode, chargeCategory, unitOfMeasure, quantityRateBasis, unitPriceRate, lineSubtotal, taxRate, totalLineAmount, timestamp, quantity, discountPercentage, baseFreightAmount, fuelSurchargeAmount, accessorialAmount, customsDutiesAmount, and taxAmount. Use null for an unavailable scalar value and an empty array when no detail or charge lines are present. Do not guess, infer, calculate, duplicate, or populate mode-specific fields unless supported by the source invoice. Keep MAWB/HAWB, Carrier SCAC Code, Delivery/Arrival Date, and Total Line Amount as the existing concepts; do not create duplicate alternatives."},{"role":"user","content":$json.rawOcrText}]
